evidence.detail: The build method looks up existing shop root widget 3824 and mutates its current child arrays rather than constructing an independent root interface.
It scans existing shop children, removes text containing exact literal 'Right-click on shop', and shifts existing stock widget 3900 vertically by 23 pixels.
It adds five clickable controls using exact tooltip 'Select shop tab' plus text labels 'Tab 1' through 'Tab 5'.
The new tab buttons use exact 'slayer/image' resources, while the observable semantic behavior remains a generic five-tab patch to the shared shop root.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 behavior name. The patch uses slayer resources, but the existing root is the shared shop interface, so a narrower SlayerShopInterface identity is not asserted.
